claims.subject: Harbor rollback gate
claims.value: Restore the previous image when the new release fails its health probe.

claims.subject: Recovery verification record
claims.value: Record the failed version, rollback result and observed health in the incident record.

claims.subject: Cedar renewal refusal
claims.value: Drain existing connections, obtain fresh credentials and reconnect through the pool when renewal is denied.

claims.subject: Credential audit fields
claims.value: Record the lease identifier, expiry and outcome without copying passwords into the incident note.

claims.subject: Finch authenticated delivery
claims.value: Verify the HMAC signature over the original request body and reject invalid signatures.

claims.subject: Repository refresh scheduling
claims.value: Valid delivery queues a repository refresh job; extraction does not run inside the HTTP handler.

claims.subject: Quartz interrupted worker
claims.value: Another worker may reclaim unfinished local work using a renewable lease.

claims.subject: Uncertain paid model outcome
claims.value: Preserve the uncertain outcome of a lost response and require an explicit new attempt rather than automatically sending the paid request again.

claims.subject: Orion request measurement
claims.value: Request counters, latency histograms and queue depth describe an observed interval.

claims.subject: Observed metrics authority
claims.value: A dashboard reading does not authorize a configuration change.
